# Google Analytics
> Google Analytics provides tools to understand customer behavior across websites and apps, measure marketing performance, and improve business outcomes.

Google Analytics is part of Google Marketing Platform and helps organizations analyze the full customer journey across devices and channels. This site includes product overviews, feature and benefit pages, audience-specific guidance, resources, and related measurement tools.

## Product Overview
- [Google Analytics Overview](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Main product overview for Google Analytics and its core capabilities.
- [Benefits](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/benefits/): Summary of business benefits from using Google Analytics for measurement and optimization.
- [Features](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/features/): Detailed feature overview covering reporting, insights, and cross-platform measurement.
- [For Small Businesses](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/small-business/): Guidance on how smaller organizations can use analytics to grow efficiently.
- [For Enterprises](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Enterprise-focused overview of analytics capabilities for large, complex organizations.

## Solutions by Business Type
- [Small Business Solutions](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/small-business/): Analytics and marketing guidance tailored to small and growing businesses.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Measurement and activation solutions designed for enterprise teams and large datasets.
- [Analytics for Business](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Product positioning and use cases for organizations seeking customer insights.
- [Analytics Benefits](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/benefits/): Practical outcomes such as better ROI, audience understanding, and faster reporting.

## Resources
- [Resources](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/): Central hub for Google Analytics and Marketing Platform learning materials.
- [Analytics Features](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/features/): Product capability details useful for evaluation and implementation planning.

- [Google Analytics Overview](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Starting point for understanding the platform and its core use cases.

## Related Products
- [Tag Manager](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager/): Manage website and app tags without editing code directly.
- [Google Analytics](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Measurement platform for understanding users and customer journeys.
- [Google Marketing Platform](https://marketingplatform.google.com/): Parent platform connecting analytics and advertising products.

## Learning and Updates
- [Google Marketing Platform Blog](https://blog.google/products/marketingplatform/360/): Official blog for product news, announcements, and measurement best practices.
- [Resources](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/resources/): Collection of educational materials, guides, and supporting content.
- [For Small Businesses](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/small-business/): Introductory guidance for teams new to analytics and digital measurement.
- [For Enterprises](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/enterprise/): Strategic guidance for advanced analytics programs at scale.

## Key Use Cases
- [Understand Customer Journeys](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/): Learn how Analytics helps track users across devices and platforms.
- [Improve Marketing ROI](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/benefits/): See how measurement insights support campaign and budget optimization.
- [Explore Product Features](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/features/): Review reporting, insights, and integration capabilities in detail.
- [Deploy Tags Efficiently](https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/tag-manager/): Use Tag Manager to simplify measurement setup and maintenance.
